senses.zh_definition: 金妮：英语女性名字，通常是 Virginia 的昵称。
senses.en_definition: A feminine English personal name, commonly a diminutive of Virginia.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan dalam bahasa Inggeris, lazimnya nama panggilan bagi Virginia.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词；不是具有独立马来语普通词义的词。具体人物的全名须另行确认，不能由昵称反推。以下为日常可组合的姓名短语，并非固定词汇搭配。[来源：Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/ginny)。

etymology.historical_story: Ginny is traditionally an English familiar form of Virginia. Such forms illustrate how everyday address can shorten or reshape a longer personal name without creating a new ordinary vocabulary word. When Ginny appears in Malay conversation, it still identifies a person. Its established nickname relationship does not establish the full registered name of every individual who uses it. [Source: Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/ginny).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Ginny 读作“金妮”两拍，开头是 /dʒ/；联想朋友的姓名牌，直接记作人名。
